repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-session-storage
repository.purpose: Published webex-core storage adapter backed by the browser sessionStorage API. new StorageAdapterSessionStorage(basekey) keeps every namespace of one instance in a single JSON document under that sessionStorage key. bind(namespace, options) checks the namespace and logger and resolves a binding whose get, put, and del read and rewrite the document and whose clear removes the whole basekey entry for every namespace. Absent keys reject with the webex-core NotFoundError, and each call logs one info line through the bound logger. No workspace package configures it; an application places an instance in a webex-core storage adapter slot.

storage-adapter-session-storage-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations or API report are published. src/index.js default-exports StorageAdapterSessionStorage: new StorageAdapterSessionStorage(basekey); bind(namespace, options) rejects on a falsy namespace or missing options.logger, throws synchronously when the logger has no info method, and otherwise resolves a new binding exposing get, put, del, and clear. Importing the package has no side effects. Specified in src/docs/README.md.

session-storage-bounded-document.summary: At-rest JSON document stored in sessionStorage under the constructor basekey, shaped {namespace: {key: value}}. Read by _getRawData and _load, rewritten whole by _save, removed by clear. No version field, migration step, or schema check exists, and no compatibility rule is declared.

webex-core-store-adapter-interface.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; storage spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/storage/docs/README.md Public surface, MOD-017, MOD-018, MOD-020, MOD-022; code checked: src/lib/storage/make-webex-store.js)
webex-core-store-adapter-interface.summary: The adapter slots storage.boundedAdapter and storage.unboundedAdapter hold an object whose bind(namespace, {logger}) resolves a handle with get, put, del, and clear. WebexStore reads the slot on each use, binds each namespace once per store behind oneFlight inside a promise executor, turns put of undefined into del, and on clear calls clear on every binding it created. Both slots default to MemoryStoreAdapter.

webex-core-storage-errors.summary: NotFoundError, built on StorageError, exported from the package entry. Host hydration treats it as absence and any other rejection as a fault, so adapters must reject get of an absent key with it.
